notes: Release 0.9 - seamless cockpit and split (gap 0, frame painted behind the windows); the Control Center strip no longer swallows taps at the top of apps, and it and the drawer are opaque over live apps; opt-in knob navigate mode (rotation steps between options, centre clicks, double-centre toggles) with one press doing one thing; keyboard survives app updates and stays out of the vendor dialer's numpad; the phone icon opens the dialer full screen; tiles come back after a theme change; stale freeform windows swept at startup; CLOSE APPS no longer overwrites the saved layout
